question: Where are Stellar's protocol and developer meetings published, and how do I find what a meeting said about a specific CAP?

golden.answer: Notes and recordings are published at developers.stellar.org/meetings, one dated page per meeting with its video; as of 2026-11-14 the index ran from January 2024 to November 12, 2026. Search those notes for the CAP number to find the discussion. The decision itself is recorded in the CAP's file in the stellar/stellar-protocol repository, whose preamble holds its status and discussion link.
keyFacts: The official meeting record is published at developers.stellar.org/meetings.
Each meeting has its own dated page with the recording.
A CAP's file in stellar/stellar-protocol records its status and discussion link.
golden.notes: Accept a later index range. Protocol discussions and developer meetings share the same index; some dates have a separate protocol-discussion page. Pointing to the recordings on YouTube as well is correct, not required.

corroboration.claim: Meeting notes and recordings are published at developers.stellar.org/meetings, one dated page per meeting with its recording.

evidence.note: Page description: "Notes and recordings from the Stellar protocol & developers meetings"; each entry links to /meetings/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>.
The 2026-11-12 page carries the date, the host, an embedded YouTube player and written notes.
The docs repository holds the meeting pages under meetings/2024, meetings/2025 and meetings/2026 plus an Atom feed.
An independent event record for the 11/12/2026 meeting points to the same YouTube video id zTZtF1jL2H0.

corroboration.claim: As of 2026-11-14 the meeting index ran from January 2024 (2024-01-18) to 2026-11-12.
Searching the meeting notes for a CAP number finds the meeting that discussed it.

evidence.note: Index summaries name CAPs: CAP-87 and CAP-88 (2026-09-10), CAP-71 (2026-04-30), CAP-81 and CAP-82, CAP-80, CAP-74.
A meetings-only docs search for "CAP-87" returned the 2026-09-17 Protocol Discussion page and the 2026-09-10 meeting.

corroboration.claim: A CAP's file in stellar/stellar-protocol records its status and discussion link.

evidence.note: Preamble fields: Status: Implemented; Discussion: https://github.com/orgs/stellar/discussions/1915; Protocol version: 30.
Preamble fields: Status: Final; Discussion: a stellar-dev mailing-list thread; Protocol version: 12.

evidence: Sibling sweep: q-protocol-cap-process covers CAP statuses and who decides, and agrees; no battery case names the meetings index. Battery cases that mention meeting notes use them as a search surface only.
